text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Dammit...!
They completely played me...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, I can't believe I couldn't win either of them~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, neither Jungle Pocket
nor Dantsu Flame was able to
seize the crown.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"It's disappointing that we didn't win, but...
thank you, Trainer-san."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Watching today's race
helped clear my head a bit."

text_block_list.name: Older Brother
text_block_list.text: Yeah... thank you from me as well.
choice_data_list: No... I'm sorry. This was all I could do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I do have a few regrets.
Even so, I was able to show Fuji Kiseki and my brother a wonderful sight."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Fuji-san...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Pokke...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Fuji...-san...
I... I'm...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: My bad, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine, as long as you gave it your all.
Besides, the Classic Triple Crown isn't over yet."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Well, now that the festival of the Japan Derby
is over, what's next...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: It's the Kikuka Sho, Pokke-chan!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's nail it, Dants.
If we just keep building on what we've done so far...
choice_data_list: Doing things the way we have been... might not be enough anymore.
Doing things like we have been... might not be enough anymore, huh?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why's that, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Allow me to explain. The final leg of the Classic Triple Crown, the Kikuka Sho, is a 3,000-meter long-distance race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It is far more punishing than the medium distances up until now. On top of that, dedicated training is required.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haha, well, I know it's long,
but a race is a race, right?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't matter how many thousand meters it is, the strongest one wins in the end.
Let's do this, Dantsu!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yup. Ehehe~♪

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: What's your deal? Wipe that smirk off your face.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "Because~, I felt like you finally acknowledged me."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Pokke-chan's number one rival?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that all?
Still... yeah, that's right. Right now, you're number one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The same day, Hokkaido—

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Coach
text_block_list.text: You made it all the way to the Derby, Pocket...

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Coach
text_block_list.text:
"You've gotten strong.
However, if things continue like this..."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, we're gonna pump it up even more from here,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking ahead to the Kikuka Sho, we decided to focus
our training this summer on long-distance preparation.
